title: Administration of DHEA in Patients With Poor Response to Ovarian Stimulation for IVF
brief_summary: Poor responders to ovarian stimulation represents one of the most frustrating problems in reproductive medicine. The investigators hypothesize that ovarian response of those patients could improve by treating these patients with 25 mg DHEA tid for 12 weeks prior to stimulation.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women with poor response to ovarian stimulation. The definition of poor response was based on the presence of at least one of the following criteria: Age \> 40 years old, day 2 FSH \>9.5 mIU/ml, AMH \< 2ng/ml ,at least one previous COH with less than 3 oocytes retrieved, at least one cancelled attempt due to poor response, estradiol less than 500 pg/ml on the day of HCG.

Exclusion Criteria:

* All other women that do not fulfill the above mentioned criteria
